subject: SAME AS clause
notes: Rule (cite.py --check 13.18.49.4 'If an alphanumeric group item, national group item, or strongly-typed group item to which data-name-1 is subordinate contains a SIGN clause' -> OK §13.18.49.4 5)). The ExpandSameAs SIGN walk takes the clause only from a group whose ItemCategory.GroupKindsOf is Alphanumeric, National or StronglyTyped (kb/Work PB1300's sibling sweep: the walk was unfiltered, so a bit group or a variable-length group's SIGN would have been carried), applied through the shared ApplyEffectiveSign. Golden: NS SAME AS NE under `01 NG GROUP-USAGE NATIONAL SIGN LEADING SEPARATE` -> PIC S9(3) SIGN LEADING SEPARATE, BYTE-LENGTH 4; pb646_national_form_numeric pins the alphanumeric-group arm.
